subject: English
title: 英文第35題｜龜山島文章的正確敘述
question:
Which of the following is true about Turtle Island?
(A) The island is free from typhoons.
(B) No people ever lived on the island.
(C) The Milk Sea puts the island on the map.
(D) Visitors can visit the island all year round.
answer: (C) The Milk Sea puts the island on the map.
explanation:
一、找famous的同義說法
原文說牛奶海so famous，使許多人想來參觀。put a place on the map是「使某地出名、受到注意」的慣用語，故C符合；不是把島畫到地圖上。

二、逐項找反證
A說沒有颱風影響，與typhoons hit及糧食運送中斷矛盾；B說從沒人住過，但1970年代初約700人居住；D說全年開放，與文中每年12月至隔年2月休島矛盾。

三、閱讀範圍
本題依報告中的地理與開放資訊判答，並非即時旅遊公告。要看懂free from、ever、all year round等範圍用語，不能只抓島名就選。

passage:
An Island That Looks Like a Turtle

Like a giant turtle out from the sea, Guishan Island, also named Turtle Island, stands just 10 kilometers across Toucheng in Yilan, Taiwan. Under the waves of Turtle Island lies a world full of hot gas and boiling water. Around 700 people lived on Turtle Island back in the early 1970s. However, in 1976, those people had no boats coming from Taiwan every time when typhoons hit. The people on the island couldn't get the food, so the government decided to close Turtle Island and send people back to the island of Taiwan.

Like Taiwan, the mountains meet the sea around Turtle Island. And the Milk Sea around Turtle Island was so famous that many people all over the world couldn't wait to visit this place. When Turtle Island was open again in 2000, visitors could finally come back to see the beautiful island.

After the reopening of Turtle Island, people also have the chance to see dolphins and whales in the water or go hiking in the mountains to enjoy the fresh air and watch special plants and animals. However, from every December to February, the island will be closed for all the living things to take some rest. This way, visitors can watch more beautiful sights and animals next time they go back to Turtle Island.

原卷詞註：government 政府；reopening 重新開張；dolphin 海豚；whale 鯨魚。
